heroFamilies.Aluxes: Background: the misty edge of a Yucatán jungle where a milpa (cornfield) begins: tall corn stalks, big tropical leaves and ferns, a few pale limestone rocks, soft diffused daylight and drifting mist, in jade and emerald greens.

subjects.AL1-H01-kitten: the cutest alux of all: even tinier and rounder than the other aluxes, a small carved jade-green stone figure come to life, with smooth sculpted stone skin, a carved straw hat a size too big for him sitting low over huge gentle wide eyes with a sweet shy look, a big round nose, chubby cheeks, a small carved sash with fine incised spiral patterns and one little red bead, tiny huarache sandals. Not a god, not a king, no crown, no halo, no idol. He sits in the little dark doorway of his doll-sized house of stacked pale limestone with a tiny palm-thatch roof, at the edge of the cornfield, hugging a golden ear of corn almost as big as himself, with a small friendly spotted dog curled up beside the doorstep. Cosy, tender, captivating.
subjects.AL1-H01-bigcat: the cutest alux of all: even tinier and rounder than the other aluxes, a small carved jade-green stone figure come to life, with smooth sculpted stone skin, a carved straw hat a size too big for him sitting low over huge gentle wide eyes with a sweet shy look, a big round nose, chubby cheeks, a small carved sash with fine incised spiral patterns and one little red bead, tiny huarache sandals. Not a god, not a king, no crown, no halo, no idol. Now he is the proud little caller of the rain: he stands on the palm-thatch roof of his doll-sized limestone house with his chest puffed out and both tiny arms raised to the sky, a content smile on his face, as the first soft rain falls in glittering drops over the tall corn around him, his small spotted dog looking up at him adoringly from the doorstep. Proud and funny, still tiny and adorable.
subjects.AL1-D04: a small alux, a knee-high spirit of the Maya cornfield: a stout, round little character that looks like a small carved jade-green stone figure come to life, with smooth sculpted stone skin, fine incised spiral and step patterns carved on his sash and the brim of his hat, a big round nose, wide friendly eyes, chubby cheeks, a broad happy smile, a carved round straw hat, a carved sash with one small red bead, and huarache sandals. Gentle, whimsical, a little mischievous, never scary. This alux has only just been carved and shaped by the healer: parts of him are still rough uncarved stone and clay, with a few thumbprints and unfinished edges, one arm still stiff, and he is sitting up for the very first time on a woven palm mat under a palm-thatch shelter, blinking with wonder, a small clay bowl of corn kernels beside him.
